teaser: Four drafts of the same email, the last one shorter than the first. You are a life path 1, the leader, crossed with an INTJ, the architect, and the shortening is the tell: the number and the type both want the final word to carry weight and nothing else. The 1 is here to prove it can stand without help; the INTJ already distrusts anything that hasn't been tested against its own judgment. Put the two in one person and the quiet becomes a kind of armor — not performance, just distance kept on purpose.
